source_title: Samsung RF28R7351SR spec sheet (Water Filter HAF-QIN / DA97-17376B)
filter_location_text: Samsung support guidance varies by model — consult the user manual for internal filter housing location on French-door models with external water dispensers.
replacement_steps_summary: Samsung support guidance for HAF-QIN filters: turn off water supply, rotate the old filter counterclockwise to unlock and remove, install the new filter clockwise until locked, then flush several gallons and reset the filter indicator.
cautions: Samsung support recommends genuine Samsung water filters only and replacing approximately every six months or when the filter indicator prompts. Samsung documents separate HAF-QIN and HAF-CIN filter families for different refrigerator lines; a HAF-CIN (DA29-00020B) cartridge is a different family and may not fit where HAF-QIN is required — using the wrong family can risk damage to the filter housing or water path. Compare the marketing name and OEM number on your old filter before ordering.
